text:
sara-peopleops: Quick sync - Lina (remote, Portland) starts Mon 3/30. Open: I-9 name mismatch (offer shows Hart, passport Perez), BG check flagged identity mismatch, and day-1 schedule (benefits + product). Thoughts? :wave:

mike-it: For devices I need final shipping name & address. If name on ID doesn't match shipping label things get messy. Prefer to wait for verification before shipping. :package:

alex-recruiter: Lina emailed that she changed her last name after offer and uploaded marriage cert and a signed name-change affidavit to the portal earlier today. I've noted it in Workday.

emily-compliance: Affidavit alone won't satisfy I-9 remote verification. Options for OR remote hires: 1) authorized agent (notary/local HR) to inspect docs, 2) approved ID verification kiosk. We can also use a designated verifier if someone local volunteers and signs the verifier form.

sara-peopleops: Any volunteers in Portland for verification? If not, we can book a UPS notary or our concierge partner.

lina-newhire: Hi all, I'm Lina. I can go to a UPS notary Fri morning or meet a concierge. Morning slots are easier. I uploaded passport + marriage cert to the secure HR upload now. :slightly_smiling_face:

bg-check-bot: BG vendor update - Case VND-987654: STATUS = IDENT_MATCH_ISSUE. Action: vendor needs gov ID + name-history docs. ETA 48-72h after docs received.

emily-compliance: @lina please ensure passport and marriage certificate are uploaded to the vendor portal or sent to secure-hr. That should resolve the vendor flag once they re-run.

eva-office-svcs: We have two verified concierges in Portland who can do same-week verifications for a $60 fee. If Lina can do a morning slot we can schedule.

mike-it: IT process: once compliance marks "verified" I will release laptop for shipping with signature required. If verification happens at concierge address we can hold package for pickup.

alex-recruiter: Would Tue 3/31 morning for benefits intro work? We normally do benefits at 10am PT and product at 2pm PT. I'll tentatively hold the 10am.

sara-peopleops: Proposed plan: Lina books UPS notary Fri AM, uploads passport + marriage cert to portal now. Vendor re-runs BG (48-72h). Compliance confirms, IT ships Friday PM (hold if not cleared). Sara will send calendar invites after confirmation. Sound good? :+1:

lina-newhire: Booked UPS notary Fri 3/27 9:15am and uploaded both docs to portal. Thanks! :raised_hands:

bg-check-bot: Vendor received documents for VND-987654. Re-run queued.

emily-compliance: Once vendor confirms identity match, I'll attach verification record to Workday and notify IT to ship. Please capture the notary receipt screenshot in the case notes.

sara-peopleops: I'll update the onboarding checklist and convert the 10am invite to confirmed after compliance OK. Thanks everyone! :tada:
